comparison.objective: Install a retained rack bracket, versus seat a platform on three kinematic datums.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require multi-feature rigid-part alignment and level lowering; candidate additionally asserts sequential hooks/latches, but those features are undocumented.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires unknown mounts locked and self-supporting; PR requires three matched supports bearing load within tight pose/force tolerances after release.
comparison.reason: The shared core may be multi-datum seating, and absent candidate CAD prevents establishing a distinct retention challenge.
